about: An ast-grep-ignore names the tool id <rule-id>.<language>, the only form ast-grep honours, and counts under <rule-id>; one naming only the rule id of a rule written per language silences nothing and is refused; a single-language rule's id is its tool id; an id no rule file has counts as written (2.1-M257, canopi-f47t.52.228.28)

id: no-foo.typescript
language: typescript
severity: error
message: 'no foo'
rule:
  pattern: foo()
